title: An afternoon sprint: to-dos that fill a progress ring, with a 2-hour deadline
prompt:
Ship this feature before standup in 2 hours. Build a sprint page: a checklist of 4 or 5 to-dos for the feature, a 2-hour countdown to the deadline that starts when clicked, and a progress ring headed "Ship the feature" that fills as the to-dos are ticked. Under the ring show the standup time ("Standup at 10:00"), a picture of the finished state, and, once every to-do is ticked, the message "Shipped!". The picture must be an inline with a data:image/svg+xml,... src and alt text (no other network requests are allowed). Use only the components in components.json and follow docs/state-and-shell.md: stores in the stable shell, the content inside
, no script.

assert.eval: (() => { const i = document.querySelectorAll('#outlet ui-todo-item'); return i.length >= 4 && i.length <= 5 && [...i].every(x => !x.checked); })()

assert.step: One progress ring headed "Ship the feature", starting at 0
assert.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelectorAll('#outlet ui-progress'); return p.length === 1 && p[0].getAttribute('variant') !== 'bar' && /ship the feature/i.test(p[0].getAttribute('heading') || '') && p[0].percent === 0; })()

assert.step: Its meta slot names the standup time
Its image slot is an inline data: picture with alt text
assert.eval: (() => { const img = document.querySelector('#outlet ui-progress img[slot="image"], #outlet ui-progress [slot="image"] img'); return !!img && img.src.startsWith('data:image/') && img.alt.trim().length > 0; })()

assert.step: A "Shipped!" done slot, hidden for now
assert.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#outlet ui-progress'); const d = p.querySelector('[slot="done"]'); return !!d && /shipped/i.test(d.textContent) && p.shadowRoot.querySelector('slot[name="done"]').parentElement.hidden; })()

assert.step: A 2-hour deadline countdown, waiting for a click
assert.eval: (() => { const c = document.querySelectorAll('#outlet ui-countdown'); return c.length === 1 && c[0].remaining === 7200 && !c[0].running; })()

assert.step: Wait for the store to update
The ring moved, but is not full
assert.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#outlet ui-progress').percent; return p > 0 && p < 100; })()

(async () => { for (let n = 0; n < 10; n++) { const i = [...document.querySelectorAll('#outlet ui-todo-item')].find(x => !x.checked); if (!i) return true; i.shadowRoot.querySelector('.check').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 80)); } return false; })()

assert.step: Wait for the store to update
The ring is full and shows "Shipped!"
assert.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#outlet ui-progress'); return p.percent === 100 && !p.shadowRoot.querySelector('slot[name="done"]').parentElement.hidden; })()
